# SeenBy

> GEO agency in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia helping SME businesses get discovered and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

## Services

- [GEO Audit — Starter](https://www.seenby.my/#pricing): One-time audit (RM 800) scoring AI visibility across five dimensions: citability, brand authority, content quality, technical foundations, and structured data. Delivered in 48 hours with two PDF reports and a 45-minute walkthrough call.
- [Growth Retainer](https://www.seenby.my/#pricing): Monthly GEO optimization from RM 2,500. Includes ongoing schema markup, llms.txt maintenance, competitor monitoring, 30-day social media calendar, email nurture sequences, brand mention scanning, and monthly GEO score reports.

## How It Works

- [How SeenBy Works](https://www.seenby.my/#how-it-works): Four-step process — full 48-hour audit, scored priority fix list, implementation by SeenBy, and monthly monitoring with score tracking.

## About

- [GEO Score Explained](https://www.seenby.my/#score): SeenBy's 5-dimension GEO Score framework measuring AI search visibility across citability, brand authority, content quality, technical foundations, and structured data.
- [FAQ](https://www.seenby.my/#faq): Answers to common questions including how GEO differs from SEO, expected timelines, website change requirements, and compatibility with existing SEO agencies.

- Founded by Muhammad Faris Irfan, AI Engineer with hands-on LLM pipeline, RAG system, and AI automation experience

- Serves Malaysian SMEs across healthcare, F&B, professional services, property, retail, and SaaS verticals
- Core service: 5-dimension GEO Score audit delivered in 48 hours
- Pricing: RM 800 one-time audit; RM 2,500/month retainer
- Registered business in Malaysia (SSM registered: SeenBy Digital)
- Industry: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search Visibility, Digital Marketing
